Retrieve Authorized Scientific Coding Sources for a User

Source: R/utils_db.R
get_user_permitted_coding_sources_db.Rd

Fetches all source IDs that the specified user is authorized to assign as scientific coding references. Administrators receive all sources unconditionally.

Usage

get_user_permitted_coding_sources_db(con, user_id, is_admin = FALSE)

Arguments

con

A DBIConnection or pool::dbPool object.

user_id

Integer representing the user's primary key in user_tokens.

is_admin

Logical; if TRUE, returns all source IDs unconditionally. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

An integer vector of permitted scientific coding source IDs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_user_permitted_coding_sources_db(con, user_id = 1L, is_admin = TRUE)
} # }
